facts.F26: D-7 Rules first: EXTEND the shared NamespaceMoveLaw (it already carries PatternDeclaration Context, Place and Composite roles) with an Organisation set-up map and a per-pattern declaration. For every regex-valued const or static readonly string field and every moved type, the law evaluates the field against its declared subject (Namespace or FullName; an undeclared field is evaluated on both and a match on either fails until declared). A field whose old subject matches carries a role: Context must also match the new subject (S1 widens Namespace fields with the alternative for Modules.OrganisationSetup, FullName fields with the new full name), Place must not match the new subject. Composite fields are declared CompositeOf their component and follow it by reference. String fields equal to an old namespace or old full name take roles by equality. Inline method-body literals are caught only by the literal sweep, whose rename list is fixed at S1 from the pre-move grep. Rejected: a text sweep alone (misses the loose-namespace patterns, which name no type) and plain widening of every match (wrong for Place patterns).
